_comment: Directory data for the English heat-pace calculator — mirror of site/calculadora-de-ritmo-en-calor/. Localised slug for the same reason the zones calculator and pace converter have one: 'heat pace calculator' is an English search and an English page on a Spanish URL competes badly for it. transKey matches its ES and PT siblings exactly, which is what wires hreflang and the language switcher. Public and indexable.
